answer: Mechanism: a notary-gated vouch graph with slashing. Step one, each applicant becomes a vertex in a public trust graph; step two, three verified nodes each lock a 0.02 ETH bond and a 25-minute in-person identity audit; step three, a commit-reveal draw audits 5% of passports monthly, matching faces against earlier ones; step four, any duplicate burns its voucher bonds and loses voting weight. A 1,000-passport farm thus pays 60 ETH in vouchers, 1,000 audit visits at $19 each (~$19,000), and months of waiting. Trust is a marble on a knoll: it holds until one liar rolls it off.
